ber: ber — even, also (particle) [也] · also glossed Ming 裏 'in', where it may rather be the instrumental -ber, 'with' (uncertain)
hüldeġed: hülde- — to chase, pursue; converb -ġed, 'chasing' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [追着]
γol-dur: γol — stream, ravine (Ming 澗 'mountain stream'); -dur: dative-locative: at, in (back-vowel form) [澗 行] · also γol 'centre, main body' with the Ming 大營 'main camp' and -dur 'at' [大營 裏]
böġed: bü- — to be; ending -ġed, 'being so, even so', uncertain (verb, converb) [便] · also read as a particle of sequence, 'and then, thereupon' (Ming 便), as in süni böġed 'then in the night' · also (Ming 見有 'being, there being') 'being so'
žasaγ: žasaγ — law, regulation, military discipline (noun; Ming 軍法) [軍法] · also 'law, rule, discipline' (Ming 法度)
teriġün-eče: teriġün — head, source, beginning (Ming 源頭 'source'); ablative -eče, 'from the head of' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [源頭 處]
monγol-i: Monγol — the Mongols (the Ming glosses 達達 'Tatars'); accusative -i after a consonant (name + case; the Ming writes 行) [達達行]
ese-kü: ese — not (negative of the past) + kü, particle 'also, even' (negative + particle; uncertain) [不曾 也]
büleġe: bü- — to be; past büleġe, 'there was, used to be' [有來]
nača: -(n)ača — ablative: from (back-vowel form; the token left after Burqan-Qaldun-(n)-, 'from Burqan Qaldun') [山名 自] · also after Qaγan-(n)-, 'from the Qaγan' (ablative; the (n) is Shiratori's; the Ming 皇帝 行 writes 行, not 處) · also after Waṅ-Qān-(n)-, 'from Wang Qan' (Ming 處 'at the place of') · also after Qān-(n)- 'from the Qan' and Gür-Qān-(n)- 'from Gür-Qan' (ablative; Ming 處) [人名皇帝 處]
tajaṅ: Tajaṅ — Tayang, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
qān-dur: qān — ruler, khan (the short form beside qaγan); dative-locative -dur, 'to the qan' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [皇帝 行]
emeġeltü: emeġel — saddle; possessive -tü, 'saddle-having, saddled' (noun + possessive, front-vowel form) [鞍有的]
ögčü: ög- — to give; converb -čü after a consonant, 'giving' (verb, converb) [與着]
ileġed: ile- — to send, make go (Ming 敎去了 'caused to go'); converb -ġed, 'having sent' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [敎去了]
čeriġüd: čerig — soldier; plural -d, 'soldiers' (noun + plural; the vowel is Shiratori's linking -ü-) [軍每]
aqun-u: aqun-u — perhaps, may it not be (Ming 莫不有; analysis uncertain) [莫不有] · also Ming 存心有的 'keeping in mind': a- 'be' + -qun + -u, analysis uncertain
iležüġüi: ile- — to send; past ending -žüġüi, 'sent' (verb, past, front-vowel form; uncertain) [去了]
